material_news_signals.headline: Jerry Jones leaves little doubt that coaching errors cost Cowboys victory over Ravens
material_news_signals.description: Cowboys owner Jerry Jones is leaving little doubt that he believes errors in game management by his coaching staff in the final seconds of a 34-31 loss to Baltimore cost his team the victory.
material_news_signals.body_text: dallas cowboys owner jerry jones is leaving little doubt that he believes errors in game management by his coaching staff in the final seconds of a 34 31 loss to the baltimore ravens cost his team the victory speaking on 105 3 the fan tuesday jones was asked what explanations there were for leaving enough seconds on the clock after a tying field goal for a defensive breakdown to put the ravens in position for the winning kick there is no explanation you re satisfied with none he said said let s be sure that we all understand that they coaches don t have one that they re satisfied with we made mistakes during that time there s no question about it so there is no explanation but there s an evaluation of how not to make the same mistakes again trailing 31 28 the cowboys had a first down at the baltimore 2 yard line with 23 seconds left when dak prescott threw incomplete into the end zone after a false start penalty against tight end luke schoonmaker prescott scrambled to the baltimore 5 and coach brian schottenheimer called his final timeout with 14 seconds remaining the coach who is also the play caller instructed prescott to either throw a quick out to receiver george pickens or throw the ball away based on the amount of time left with no ability to stop the clock prescott didn t wait long to choose the throwaway and the play lasted just four seconds schottenheimer repeatedly took accountability on tuesday for how the game s ending transpired i didn t do very good in the last 28 seconds schottenheimer said during his tuesday news conference which took place hours after jones radio show i ll take accountability for it i hurt our chance to win that game i ll be better and i m better than that i m better than i performed in the last 28 seconds schottenheimer said that he overcoached prescott on third down which then impacted the following play he and i talked on the on the plane schottenheimer said i m not going to get into too much of it because there was some schematical stuff but there was a lot going on and some of the words that i told him have meaning and it put him into a mindset where he kind of checked and felt a little push and threw it away schottenheimer added third down is where i overcoached dak and put him in a mindset that he normally doesn t play with so that s where i made the mistake like i said at the end of the day when that happens you have to move on at that point i m no longer the play caller i m the head coach the communication with special teams coordinator nick sorensen and game management coordinator ryan feeder wasn t good enough so that starts with me take responsibility for it take accountability for it those things will not happen again there were seven seconds remaining after brandon aubrey s field goal and the dallas defense left a gap at just about the exact spot of the target line for a baltimore field goal lamar jackson completed a 27 yard pass to zay flowers got the timeout called with a second to go and tyler loop made the 56 yard field goal schottenheimer is in his second season as a head coach after 25 years as an nfl assistant christian parker is a 34 year old making his debut as a defensive coordinator both will be under considerable scrutiny from fans and pundits going forward and perhaps from their own front office we will be better from this experience that we had with baltimore and what happened to us at the end of the game jones said a win would have given you another way of couching it as far as having growth and enthusiasm for having won a game like that because we did come back and we came back in an impressive way all of that makes us realize we really are just at the beginning of what i hope is an exciting year for us the cowboys 1 2 got a break in the nfc east when two time defending champion philadelphia lost to chicago and backup quarterback case keenum on monday night dallas visits houston 0 3 on sunday the new york giants who will be without quarterback jaxson dart for the rest of the regular season because of a knee injury are tied with the eagles atop the division at 2 1 we are very much in the hunt and i say that principally based upon the way i feel about our team as much or more than what s happening with the other teams jones said philadelphia has things that they want to work on just as the giants do just as we do it makes you see how health is a factor availability is a factor and we re just getting started the associated press contributed to this report

material_news_signals.description: The Jacksonville Jaguars have retrieved the football from Travis Hunter's first NFL interception after initially being refused by a ball boy after the play during Sunday's game against the New England Patriots.

veteran defensive end josh hines allen even screaming hey you can t touch me when hines allen tried to grab the ball the ball boy appeared to try to push hines allen away nfl players are allowed to material_news_signals.headline: 38-year-old Case Keenum shines as Bears demolish Eagles: 'As a kid you dream about it'
material_news_signals.description: The Chicago Bears dominated the Philadelphia Eagles on Monday night, with the offense racking up first downs and the defense shutting down Jalen Hurts and Co.
material_news_signals.body_text: case keenum showed savviness doesn t expire with age or get creaky with cobwebs in his first action since 2023 keenum dusted off his gunslinger persona and led the chicago bears to a resounding 27 7 win over the previously unbeaten philadelphia eagles on monday night it s all about case keenum and what he was able to do here tonight bears coach ben johnson told reporters after the game i thought he did an extraordinary job when the running game s not going as a play caller being able to lean into the passing game knowing that our guys are trying to protect for him he s going to get the ball out and go to the right guy in time take care of the football good decisions 24 of 34 almost 250 yards two touchdowns he just played really efficient football and i couldn t be more proud of him for that keenum starting in place of the injured caleb williams officially passed for 247 yards and added four runs for six yards including a rushing td on a sneak to ice the contest keenum became the oldest player 38 years 223 days in bears history to score a rushing touchdown breaking the previous mark held by dave krieg 38 years 49 days read that last line again in the historic 107 year history of the chicago bears keenum is the oldest player to record a rushing td and that s the sort of night it was remarkable as a kid you dream about it keenum said after the win you know you feel like you can i don t know if you think about the week that it takes the work that it takes in the offseason to clean up your diet you work extremely hard to get your body back to where it needs to be you go through a training camp as the three and grind out some reps you re getting a few reps a day you know to get a shot again to do it like this i mean yeah you dream of it that s why i m still here still doing this why i m still getting up and i ve been knocked down my whole career i just keep getting up keep coming to work and keep bouncing back keenum s winding 14 year nfl career has included highs like the minneapolis miracle and lows like when he washed out of being a regular starter however he s always owned the smarts and arm to get the ball where he needed it to go monday night he proved a perfect distributor to fill in for johnson s offense the bears had vic fangio s defense running in circles philly stymied the run game for three quarters this time around but keenum s quick papercuts bled them dry the qb was nearly flawless zipping darts outmaneuvering pressure and getting the ball exactly to the right target on time sure he got away with a couple of throws but given it s been three years since his last action it s fair to brush those aside we needed him to play that well particularly how slow we were staying on schedule in terms of that running game there for the first three quarters so not a surprise at all johnson said he tackled everything this week with enthusiasm we ve got one of the best quarterback rooms in the nfl and that was a reflection of that keenum was particularly good when fangio tried to rile him up with pressure the qb averaged 12 4 yards per attempt against the blitz and averaged 9 9 yards per attempt when pressured the 38 year old s familiarity with the style of offense johnson wants to run was evident the bears aligned under center on 58 0 of offensive plays in the win their highest rate since week 14 of the 2025 season per next gen stats they averaged 6 9 yards per play from under center posting a season high 46 2 rushing success rate and an 85 7 passing success rate the second highest under center passing success rate of a team coached by johnson he knows where everyone s supposed to be on every single play and so he s really quick to recognize coverage johnson said of keenum he knows why we re calling the play what we re looking for and if we re not getting that he s accelerating through it extremely quickly and so that s what you get when you re 15 plus years in this league playing this position you ve seen it all and i thought coach fangio threw a lot at him tonight too he ran the whole gambit of everything we ve seen on tape as far as we were concerned we saw a little bit of everything so case handled it really well so well that the bears moved to 2 1 with seeming ease against an nfc contender johnson declined to say who he planned to start in week 4 against the new york jets after monday s performance the one thing we can say with certainty is chicago isn t fretting about whoever gets the nod

material_news_signals.headline: Bears' Tyson Bagent clears concussion protocol ahead of Monday's game vs. Eagles; Caleb Williams out
material_news_signals.description: Bears backup quarterback Tyson Bagent cleared concussion protocol and will practice Saturday ahead of Chicago's Monday night game against the Eagles, head coach Ben Johnson said.
material_news_signals.body_text: the bears officially have a couple options at quarterback ahead of their monday night showdown with the eagles backup qb tyson bagent who on saturday was listed as questionable to play cleared concussion protocol on sunday and was removed from the injury report bagent progressed through protocol enough to practice in full during chicago s final practice of the week after missing the previous two sessions nfl network insider ian rapoport and espn s adam schefter reported that while ben johnson initially described bagent to reporters saturday morning as having cleared concussion protocol bagent actually progressed to the next step in the process which allowed him to practice after being symptom free into sunday bagent is in the clear though chicago hasn t named a starter with caleb williams ruled out due to a hamstring injury case keenum is also available and took starting snaps at the beginning of chicago s practice week with williams and bagent sidelined should the bears deem bagent is prepared enough to get the start it would be his first since the 2023 campaign when as an undrafted rookie he went 2 2 for the bears with 859 passing yards three touchdowns and six interceptions across five total appearances he also came in for williams on sunday against the vikings and went 5 of 9 for 54 yards during two fourth quarter possessions if the bears were to turn to keenum the 38 year old veteran would similarly be making his first start since 2023 he went 1 1 that season for the texans throwing for 291 yards one touchdown and three interceptions in what amounted to two of his four starts this decade regardless of who starts they ll have their work cut out for them against a philly defense that ranks fifth in the nfl against the pass through two weeks chicago measures up much better in the run game as the bears enter week 3 sporting the top rushing offense they ll likely look to attack the eagles 23rd ranked run defense on the ground with d 39 andre swift and kyle monangai however the passing game will still have a plethora of difference makers available in colston loveland rome odunze and luther burden as well as swift and monangai on shorter area targets we ll see what johnson draws up when the bears kick off against the eagles on monday at 8 15 p m et

material_news_signals.description: The Giants have acquired quarterback J.J. McCarthy from the Vikings in a trade, Minnesota announced Monday.
material_news_signals.body_text: the minnesota vikings have officially moved on from j j mccarthy the vikings traded the 2024 no 10 overall pick to the new york giants in exchange for a 2027 fifth rounder the team announced on monday minnesota cashed out on mccarthy after just 10 starts in which he struggled mightily with accuracy the vikings move on from the 23 year old was telegraphed during the offseason when the club sought free agent kyler murray and re signed veteran carson wentz minnesota gave mccarthy a cursory shot to win a job during training camp but he ultimately was squeezed out mccarthy missed his entire rookie season after suffering a preseason knee injury the vikings then watched sam darnold and daniel jones walk out of the building during the 2025 offseason handing the reins to their first round pick mccarthy however struggled to stay healthy and when on the field was scattershot showing only brief glimpses of consistently moving the offense in his 10 starts last year his only appearances in a vikings jersey mccarthy completed 57 6 of his passes for 1 632 yards with 11 touchdowns and 12 interceptions during training camp and preseason the struggles continued and it became clear the vikings couldn t trust mccarthy even as the primary backup with the former first rounder relegated to an inactive emergency third qb to start the season it was only a matter of time before minnesota shipped him out of town the move clears roughly 4 5 million from the vikings books not nothing but a pittance for the qb position kevin o connell once famously said i believe that organizations fail young quarterbacks before young quarterbacks fail organizations in relation to mccarthy the giants are hoping the vikings gave up on the youngster too quickly with jaxson dart out for the regular season after suffering a week 2 knee injury the giants planned to bring in more quarterback help mccarthy s arrival gives john harbaugh s team a young passer to build the cardinals all the other conversation isn t going to help us beat the cardinals so it s irrelevant harbaugh said jameis will be the starter for as long as i can see into the future big blue now has another option if winston s play further deteriorates or he gets injured the giants previously signed jake haener one career start with new orleans from the practice squad to the active roster for sunday s win over the titans how quickly mccarthy gets up to speed in the new offense could determine when he might see the field for new york

material_news_signals.description: Jalon Daniels will start at quarterback for the Buccaneers with Baker Mayfield sidelined by his thumb injury.
material_news_signals.body_text: for the first time in four years the buccaneers will be starting someone other than baker mayfield at quarterback in week 4 bucs head coach todd bowles told reporters on monday that mayfield will miss a minimum of three weeks after dislocating his right thumb in the team s 23 16 loss to the vikings on sunday tampa bay will start undrafted rookie jalon daniels in mayfield s place when it hosts the 1 2 packers on oct 4 daniels went 0 for 3 passing with a game ending interception after coming on in relief of mayfield against minnesota daniels also gained 9 yards on one rushing attempt the last qb other than mayfield to start for tampa was tom brady back in the 2022 season nfl network insider ian rapoport reported earlier on monday that an mri revealed no ligament or tendon damage to mayfield s thumb the injury occurred on a fourth and 1 play in the fourth quarter on sunday when the qb was hit by linebacker blake cashman as he threw a pass that was intercepted based on what bowles said on monday it appears the earliest return date for mayfield is week 7 when the bucs will visit the division rival panthers it s been a dreadful start to the season for the bucs who are still searching for their first win the 31 year old mayfield signed a three year 165 million contract extension five days before the start of the 2026 season through three games he has the lowest epa per dropback 0 30 of any quarterback with at least 50 pass attempts this season per next gen stats before signing with the bucs after going undrafted in april daniels 23 spent six seasons at kansas where he became the first four time team captain in school history he beat out jake browning for the backup job with a strong showing in camp and now gets an opportunity to spark the offense against a green bay team that just gave up 35 points to the previously lifeless falcons the bucs do not have any other qbs on the 53 man roster but they do have 31 year old easton stick on the practice squad stick is in his seventh nfl season and started four games for the chargers in 2023
